game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled lantern oil but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: In Bat Hollow, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled lantern oil but keep the loop running. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the exit ledge using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The exit ledge reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the exit ledge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Continue Gate' (Week 4 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Bat Hollow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The exit ledge reached with actions_used <= 17.
